expected_outcomes: A reader can determine applicability, output, evidence, and escalation without hidden context.
required_actions: Provide all required authoring sections and unambiguous requirement vocabulary.
expected_documents: Normative standard following the standard authoring template.
acceptance: Required sections, provenance, ownership, review cycle, examples, and anti-patterns are present.
verification: Validate the standard against the authoring contract and registry schema.
evidence: Schema-valid record, linked human document, and source record.
failure_conditions: Mandatory behavior is hidden behind ambiguous vocabulary or missing evidence.
exceptions: Record an approved exception with rule ID, scope, risk, control, owner, and expiry.
